data.gender_notes: Vikaransh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vikaransh means 'one who acts'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vikar' which means 'action' and 'ansh' which means 'a part'. This name signifies the one who takes action and leads from the front. The name Vikaransh carries the meaning “One who acts” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vikaransh usually hope their child will grow to embody one who acts and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vikaransh is a spiritually significant name in Hinduism. It signifies the individual's inner strength and courage to take action towards their goals.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vikaransh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Vikaransh was a legendary king of the Solar Dynasty, ruling during the Mahabharata era. He is best known for his defeat of the demon king Vrishakapi, who had taken the form of a horse and had wreaked havoc on the people of the kingdom. After a fierce battle, Vikaransh was able to defeat the demon and save his people.

Vikaransh is also mentioned in the Puranas, particularly the Agni Purana, as a great king of the Ikshvaku dynasty. He is known for his piety and his devotion to the god Agni. During his reign, he performed a grand yajna (sacrifice) to appease the god and ensure the prosperity of his kingdom.
